blocker.summary: r470 fixed the long-standing campaign-to-world transition stall (characterized r463-r469): tools/run_gate.py's --mission-render-summary route sent Escape instead of a fourth A/space confirm on a 'Deploy with this selection?' dialog it mislabeled as a cinematic (verified by viewing the previously-uninspected screenshots -- the last 6 captures of every prior run were byte-identical). This corrects r469's premise (hangar/map confirms were already being sent automatically by --mission-render-summary; the real gap was this fifth confirm). Fixed and committed in run_gate.py. Verified live: run 1 reached '[ac6-visual-phase] cinematic=0 world=1 hud=1 stable=30' for the first time in this whole campaign, captured a real flight HUD screenshot, and dumped 482 shader files (241 distinct hashes, only 2 new vs the existing 253-hash baseline -- new (hash,modification) pairs are still possible but not yet determined). NOT resolved: the captured pipeline cache is .fsi.vk.xpso, but rexglue_shader_translate/ requires .fbo.vk.xpso to match the r254/r255 methodology; a second run with --mission-host-render-targets (which should force fbo per source) neither changed the filename nor reproduced world=1 (stalled differently). Also corrected a standing methodological assumption: r463-r469 all backed up/restored build/ntsc-uj/manifest.json believing it shared with the native profile -- it is not; native has its own separate manifest at build/ntsc-uj/native/manifest.json, and ctest doesn't even read either file. The native profile was never actually at risk from this whole oracle-campaign chain. ctest 11/11, no regression. Named for r471: resolve the .fsi/.fbo cache format mismatch, then resume the shader-translation pipeline on the 241-shader dump. Still open, non-blocking: why --mission-host-render-targets breaks reproduction of the fix; the PinnedShaderRuntime backlog commit decision (r433/r434/r438/r454-r470).
